rule_checks.detail: No substitute proposed yet — impact assessment only.

answer.narrative: Three legs lose their Captain immediately — DX412, DX413 and DX588 on 15 Sep (486 passengers). Because P-2291 is a two-day pairing that overnights at DEL, day 2 (DX589/DX590/DX591 on 16 Sep) is also at risk: whoever covers day 1 must take the whole pairing, or day 2 is stranded at the wrong base.

narration: Three legs are uncrewed on 15 Sep — DX412, DX413, DX588, 486 passengers. Day 2 (DX589/590/591) is at risk because the pairing overnights at DEL.
